confirmed_issues.title: Note correction republishes unchanged text
confirmed_issues.reproduction: Patient > Visit notes > Send a corrected version on the new synthetic note.
confirmed_issues.observed: Version 1 became version 2 with identical content, without any editor or confirmation.
confirmed_issues.impact: Patients cannot use this control to correct their note; it creates a misleading correction event.
confirmed_issues.suggested_fix: Open a prefilled edit/preview flow and submit only intentional corrected content.

confirmed_issues.title: Reading and symptom timestamps share state
confirmed_issues.reproduction: Patient > Home readings; set Measured at to 2026-10-03T12:00.
confirmed_issues.observed: Occurred at changed to 2026-10-03T12:00 as well, confirmed through both visible fields and DOM values. No extra event was saved.
confirmed_issues.impact: Editing one form can silently change the time used by the other form.
confirmed_issues.suggested_fix: Maintain independent timestamp state for readings and symptoms.

confirmed_issues.title: PDF blood-pressure labels lose systolic/diastolic distinction
confirmed_issues.reproduction: Patient > Export visit summary > Download summary.
confirmed_issues.observed: PDF lists Blood pressure: 138 mmhg and Blood pressure: 86 mmhg with identical labels; patient UI labels 138 as Systolic BP.
confirmed_issues.impact: The exported record is ambiguous outside the application.
confirmed_issues.suggested_fix: Export canonical Systolic BP/Diastolic BP labels or a paired 138/86 mmHg row while preserving source evidence.

confirmed_issues.title: Successful approval is presented as not ready to publish
confirmed_issues.reproduction: Reviewer > uploaded audit report > Review > Approve 1 reviewed entry.
confirmed_issues.observed: Publication succeeded at revision 8, but the page remained with This review is not ready to publish / This review was already published, plus Review, Exclude, Correct and manual-entry controls.
confirmed_issues.impact: Successful completion looks like a warning/failure and exposes actions that should appear locked or start a separate amendment.
confirmed_issues.suggested_fix: Show Published status, link to the released record and disable draft editing for published batches.

confirmed_issues.title: Patient note and upload dates disagree with local clinic timestamps
confirmed_issues.reproduction: Submit the synthetic note and upload shortly after midnight on 4 October 2026 in Asia/Kolkata.
confirmed_issues.observed: Patient UI says submitted/uploaded 03 October 2026, while clinic history/queue shows Oct 04, 2026, 12:07/12:11 AM.
confirmed_issues.impact: The same event appears to happen on different dates across roles.
confirmed_issues.suggested_fix: Format timestamp-derived calendar dates in one documented local timezone; keep actual source collection dates separate.

additional_concerns.title: Static five-year scenario appears for the second clinic patient with no approved results
additional_concerns.observed: Second clinic own P0482 patient has approval revision 0 and no documents, but its Master dashboard shows the same static 2022–2026 scenario. The scenario API checks the identifier P0482 rather than an explicit scenario assignment.
additional_concerns.interpretation: This is a synthetic fixture-provenance/UI concern, not evidence that private observations or events crossed tenants. Explicit scenario assignment or more prominent separation from real record data would reduce confusion.

additional_concerns.title: History role labels are confusing for export events
additional_concerns.observed: System export-ready events and an earlier export-request event for Dr Meera Nair appeared with Patient role in history.
additional_concerns.interpretation: Verify whether actorRole captures identity capability or action context; use consistent labels.
